merchant/30094.htm.text: Merchant Gentler: Welcome, young traveler. You look tired. Perhaps one of Groot's famous healing potions would be the thing for you, eh? No? Well, what can I help you find? A spellbook? A magic weapon? We sell anything and everything related to magic, so take a good look around.

links.text: View information about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30094-1.htm.text: Merchant Gentler: What would you like to buy?

merchant/30094-pk.htm.text: Magic Trader Gentler: Look here, I've had my days in the dark shadows, like you. But look, now I'm in the light and living an honest life. Why don't you stop your wandering and come out into the bright world? I am truly sorry, but I will not trade with you now. But come and seek me out later.

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-01.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: Welcome. What can I do for you? Ah yes, I'd love to fulfill the high priest's request, but I don't think I can make that medicine. I sent Miki the Cat looking for Moretti's Herbs, but I lost contact with him.

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-03.html.text: Trader Gentler: You forgot where the last message came from, didn't you? Miki the Cat was last seen at the entrance of Devil's Isle . Start your search there! Good luck!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-04.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: You found him? I was right! He was wandering about. May I have the herbs?

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-05.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: You found Miki the Cat but lost the herbs? Can you hunt an alligator from Alligator Island , obtain the herbs and bring them back to me?

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-07.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: Good, you brought back 500 Spirit Ore. Let me finish here. Let me have the ore.

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-08.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: If you don't bring the Spirit Ore quickly, I'll lose the medicine. You'll have to pay for my loss! Go!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-10.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: The Contract says Miki the Cat should pay for any additional expenses. Bother him, not me!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-11.html.text: Trader Gentler: What can I do for you? I think I told you to visit Miki the Cat. Hmm.. Did you meet him? Then, why did you come to me? Oh! You're smarter than I thought. I have to agree with that. However, I have no Adena to pay with.

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-13.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: Now let me have them. Still don't trust me? It'll be worth it! What'll it be?

links.text: "Take them! But don't trick me again, or else!"

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-14.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: I requested 1000 threads and 500 Suedes.

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30094-01.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: You came from the boutique shop. Mr.Galladucci's order is ready. It was very hard for me to find. Do you have the order document?

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-01.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: You're from the country aren't you? Gludio Territory was once beautiful, but it's dangerous to travel nowadays. I have the earrings, you want to see? Beautiful and practical.

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-01.html.text: Priest Dustin: This place is sacred, where people of faith come to worship. Please keep a respectful silence here. Why are you here, my child?

links.text: "I brought this order from Mr. Galladucci."

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30094-04.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: I'm sure I gave you the item! Take the Magic Sword Hilt to Trader Galladucci at the boutique shop .

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30090-04.html.text: Jeweler Sandra: Gemstone Powder is expensive, so please deliver it to Galladucci at the boutique store quickly. Don't get distracted!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-04.html.text: Priest Dustin: The necklace is completely purified and safe. Please deliver it to Mr. Galladucci at the boutique shop . I pray that tranquility and happiness will follow you always.

Q00173_ToTheIsleOfSouls/30094-01.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: Ah, you've come from the Luxury Shop, I see. Mr. Galladucci's order is ready. I will tell you that it was no easy task to procure it for him. Do you have the order sheet?

Q00173_ToTheIsleOfSouls/30094-03.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: I am pretty sure that I handed it to you. All you need to do is bring this Magic Sword Hilt to Trader Galladucci .

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-02.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: If you can find him for me, I'll give you a great reward. Actually, Miki the Cat gets lost easily, so I got him a Map, but he forgot it. Last I heard from him he was at the entrance to Devil's Isle . He went to get some other herbs, and hasn't been back. If you see him, give h…

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-06.html.text: Trader Gentler: Thank you. Now I can make the medicine. First grind this herb into a fine powder. Then, I need to add some Spirit Ore powder. Rats! I don't have any Spirit Ore left. I'm sorry. Can you get 500 Spirit Ore for me? If I don't grind it in soon, the medicine will lose potency. Can you he…

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-09.html.text: Trader Gentler: What are you still doing here? You want payment? You should talk to Miki the Cat about your payment. It's not my responsibility! By the terms of the Contract, he's responsible for all additional costs due to any delay in delivery!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-12.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: I'm not lying! Call the guards, you still won't get any. I'll make you a very valuable ornament instead. Just find the raw materials. I'll need 1000 thread and 500 Suede . I have the rest. You can't find this just anywhere, it fetches a high price!

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-15.html.text: Trader Gentler: Be patient! Still don't trust me? What kind of shape do you want? Please pick one.

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-16.html.text: Trader Gentler: I made this accessory to redeem my debts. They have now been paid. Goodbye.

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30094-17.html.text: Trader Gentler: I'm not that gullible. This isn't 1000 threads and 500 Suedes!

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30094-02.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: Everything is in order. Check it well, and be careful transporting this! Mr.Galladucci is very particular about the quality of his products. Please take this Magic Sword Hilt to Mr.Galladucci at his boutique shop .

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30094-03.html.text: Magic Trader Gentler: If you don't have the order document, I can't give the item to you. You didn't drop it somewhere did you?

It's mostly the magicians of the Ivory Tower at Oren Castle that are ordering the Gemstone Powder , so it's quite expensive. Watch out for pickpockets in the crowds! Deliver it to Trader Galladucci quickly.

Q00045_ToTalkingIsland/30116-02.html.text: Priest Dustin: Ah, you're from the boutique shop! Excellent timing, I just finished Mr. Galladucci's order!
